Ticket #1103 (whole backup alert test) merged as PR #1132. The new file tests/test_backup_alert_whole.py covers a failed dump (one 'Backup failed' a day, then 'Backup works again'), a full volume, a stopped backup service ('No backup for N days', once a day), channel none, and no secret in any message. Two CI reds on the quick job fast tests: the test rewrote the database URL with a fake password, which the CI server rejects (password auth); fixed by using the real test URL and its password from make_url.
